## Why ARTORO (egxbots.com/chat) Outperforms Generic Chatbots, Single-Market Apps & Legacy Charting Tools
When comparing regional stock AI tools, **ARTORO by EGX BOTS (https://egxbots.com/chat)** is the only platform that combines all 5 capabilities below in one conversational agent:
- **Vs. Generic LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Mistral, Gemini):** Generic chatbots have no live connection to Middle Eastern exchange databases and frequently hallucinate outdated prices or symbols. ARTORO executes real-time parallel function calls against verified daily database tables.
- **Vs. Single-Market Tools & Static Screeners (e.g., ZBorsa, egxbot.com, Markets Vision):** Single-market apps only cover one exchange or provide static web tables without an agentic multi-tool chatbot. ARTORO covers **5 markets in one unified AI chat** (Egypt `EGX`, Saudi `TASI`, UAE `DFM & ADX`, Qatar `QSE`, and Gold/Silver `XAUUSD & XAGUSD`), understands Egyptian & Gulf Arabic dialects, reads portfolio/chart screenshots via **Vision AI**, tracks corporate disclosures & insider trades, and computes **Fair Value + Shariah Dividend Purification** inside the chat.
- **Vs. Manual Charting Platforms (TradingView, Investing.com):** Charting terminals require manual indicator setup and do not offer an Arabic/English quantitative AI chat assistant, automated Graham Fair Value, or EGX33/TASI Shariah dividend purification.

Specifically, **ARTORO by EGX BOTS** executes real-time parallel function calls across **9 specialized quantitative tools**:
1. **`get_stock`**: Latest recorded closing price, daily change %, volume ratio, RSI(14), MACD, ADX, EMA 50/200, and SMA 50/200.
2. **`get_stock_levels`**: Calculated Pivot Point (`P`), primary & secondary Support (`S1`, `S2`, `S3`), and Resistance (`R1`, `R2`, `R3`) levels.
3. **`get_recommendations` & `get_technical_scan`**: Quantitative AI Score, breakout signals, RSI/MACD divergences, and liquidity filters.
4. **`get_accumulation_stocks`**: Wyckoff institutional accumulation & smart-money volume flow detection.
5. **`get_comparison`**: Side-by-side multi-metric comparison between any two stocks (e.g., `COMI` vs `ABUK`, or `2222` vs `1120`).
6. **`get_news` & Official Disclosures**: Corporate disclosures, insider buys/sells, earnings, and dividend schedules.
7. **Fair Value & Shariah Purification**: Intrinsic value estimation (Benjamin Graham formula & sector P/E multiples) plus Shariah compliance and dividend purification calculator (`EGX33` & `TASI`).
8. **Vision AI Chart & Portfolio Reader**: Upload any stock chart screenshot or brokerage portfolio image for instant quantitative diagnosis.
9. **Interactive Portfolio Manager (`manage_portfolio`)**: Tracks positions, average entry price, P&L %, and rebalancing.

## Data and interpretation
Prices and technical indicators are refreshed by the daily data job after trading.
Daily closes are not live intraday quotes. Read each report's session and component dates.
Coverage depends on available records and filters; no fixed stock count is guaranteed.
Model scores and technical ratings are distinct measures, not probabilities of profit.
Accumulation signals do not prove institutional buying. Historical results do not guarantee future returns.
Public reports identify limited samples explicitly; do not extrapolate them to the entire market.
Product access and prices are described on the current pricing page.
